questions.stem: The case below gives the figures. A workflow trace records 2498 steps and the reviewer must identify asymptotic dominance in the trace. Which statement about asymptotic dominance is correct for these steps?

options.text: Lower growth wins for large n

questions.explanation: asymptotic dominance: For large inputs an n log n algorithm outperforms a quadratic one even if it has larger constant overhead. Option C is correct: Lower growth wins for large n. Option A is wrong because it overvalues constants at scale. Option B is wrong because it assumes order of listing matters. Option D is wrong because it denies complexity impact.
questions.hint: Which matters more as n grows, constants or growth rate?
